## Everything Will Be OK

_by Kantiki Jayamana Whateva_

For those of you who've already read the raw drafts or listened to me ramble about this project over the years... it’s almost ready. Or, to quote Rocky: _"It's time go!"_

I still need to nail down the prologue and epilogue -- two massive pieces of the puzzle that absolutely cannot be left on the cutting room floor. Toss in a little reworking on two of the core chapters and we're golden.

The initial drop will be digital, backed up by print-on-demand for the physical copies. But back in 2025, I made a call: I'm doing a limited run of 100 physical copies for each of my books. Twenty of those are earmarked as gifts for friends, family, and the tribe. The other 80? Those are going to be "traveling books." Once Trinity is fully built out and I hit the road to roam the States full-time, I’ll be leaving these copies scattered across the country for the universe to distribute. Just like the leafshredders on BookCrossing, this story is going to have its own physical journey.

For the folks who have no idea what this book is even about... look, generally speaking, I am dead-set against time travel stories. But I'm breaking my own rule with this one. I'm tackling the trope in a way that I think is funny as all hell, and it's gonna hit home for alotta peeps... especially my fellow "grunge kids" who grew up in the '90s.

I'm eyeing a release as early as 2027. We'll see what the winds of change have to say about it.

### Extended Exploration

This book was very much born during the 2am printing marathons that Zero and I would make at Kinko's back in the day. Some of our best works came from those nights, but I wouldn't call many of them "digestible for the public" lol. This is a rare exception on that list. As such, it's firmly rooted in [The adHF](adhd-revolution) and [The ADHD Revolution](adhd-revolution), with a satirical style not too dissimilar to "[Landlore](landlore)" itself... but science fiction. On the sci-fi side, you'd love my [surreal fractalscapes](other-fractalscapes) which pull heavily from the genre.
